context: Two news editors prep a feature on community issues
purpose: Teach: 閉鎖/破綻/放棄/収容/虐待/誘導/消滅/陥っ

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 雪さん、今回の特集なんですけど、駅前の児童館が来月で閉鎖になるって話、知ってました？
lines.en: Yuki-san, about this feature — did you hear the children's center by the station is closing next month?
lines.style: Curious junior reporter raising a topic respectfully.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 聞いた聞いた。運営してたNPOが経営破綻したらしいよ。予備資金もとっくに底ついてたって。
lines.en: Yeah, I heard. The NPO running it apparently went bankrupt. Their reserves dried up ages ago.
lines.style: Experienced editor sharing background information matter-of-factly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: それ書きますか？でも、ただ閉鎖の事実だけじゃ弱い気がして……地域全体が機能を放棄してる感じも出したいんですよね。
lines.en: Should we write about that? But just the closure feels weak — I want to show the whole area abandoning its function.
lines.style: Eager writer pitching a deeper editorial angle.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: いい視点。実はあそこ、最大五十人を収容してて、虐待の通報窓口にもなってたの。消えると影響でかいよ。
lines.en: Good angle. Actually it housed up to fifty kids and was an abuse-report contact point. Losing it hits hard.
lines.style: Senior colleague affirming and adding crucial context calmly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 児童虐待の相談先まで消滅するってことですか……それ、見出しに使えますよ。読者の視線を誘導できる強さがある。
lines.en: So even the abuse hotline disappears? That could be the headline — strong enough to pull readers in.
lines.style: Excited reporter recognising editorial potential immediately.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ただし煽りすぎ注意ね。事実関係きちんと裏取って、行政が機能不全に陥ってる構造まで踏み込もう。
lines.en: Just don't sensationalise. Verify the facts properly, and dig into how the administration itself is malfunctioning.
lines.style: Veteran editor giving cautious professional guidance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 了解です。市の担当課にも当てて、来週には初稿出します。
lines.en: Got it. I'll reach out to the city department too and have a first draft next week.
lines.style: Junior committing to clear next steps confidently.
